pages.text: The disk drive looks like an old floppy drive. Put a disk into its slot. $(l)Save$() writes the program of the disk into the folder $(1)c0de$() of your Minecraft, next to $(1)saves$() and $(1)screenshots$(). $(l)Load$() puts a program from that folder onto the disk. This way you keep your programs on your own computer and can share them with friends.
Recipe: iron ingots in the top and bottom rows, and two smooth stone slabs with redstone dust between them in the middle row.
